title: Let Naam thin the inner dread
summary: This meets the mind still carrying weight after the deal is done. The line says true profit is the fearlessness that grows when Naam lives within.
takeaway: Let Naam quiet the dread beneath wanting.
lifeApplication: When the chest tightens after the purchase, the plan, or the numbers, stop with one hand on the sternum. Repeat the line until the breath loosens and fear is named before it drives the next choice.

source.shortMeaning: Naam turns profit into inward fearlessness rather than more burden.
source.lifeApplication: When doubt crowds the chest, return to Naam before making the next move.
